title: The observe_world cleanup test asserts only its own run dir is gone
summary: simq cleanup test captures its own run dir via a _run_for_analysis spy and asserts only that dir is gone, so xdist workers cannot fail it.

title: Baseline Semgrep findings on agent-working paths: SHA pin and nosemgrep

title: ci_lanes --run: no dangling backslash and a clear stop when xdist is missing
summary: ci_lanes strips junit flags without leaving a lone backslash and stops -n lanes with one line when pytest-xdist is not importable.

title: Own the unowned Semgrep paths in the session roles registry
summary: session_roles.yaml gives testing the rpg-gate-report workflow and ci_junit tools and agent-working handover_transit and tools/search; card budget raised to 415.
